# GREEN_STACK numerical methods recovery, part 3 of 3

Parts 1 and 2 are immutable materials [internal-source-reference] (15921 bytes, SHA256 2a921685e99d09a1a2e4fc2c7def3ebb0bc655785678cf2c57cef0cb6b695ee7) and [internal-source-reference] (14424 bytes, SHA256 03c532cf1ba8b5afbb15850ee5b221d7b6740c1b71e0d98154f3c7cfc8eb2693). These three materials together preserve complete actual search source units, exact input checkpoints and all continuation checkpoints used below. No encoded file or omitted helper is needed. Separate exact-body capsules [internal-source-reference] and [internal-source-reference] remain the authority for the exact rational C472356 and C40558 nonwinners.

## Environment, scope and replay
The actual measured numerical environment is Python 3.13.5 (GCC 14.2.0), NumPy 2.3.5, SciPy 1.17.0 and Torch 2.10.0+cpu. The code sets Torch float64 and one Torch thread. Commands below set OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1; stack_opt.py sets OMP_NUM_THREADS=1. No GPU is used. Floating search and nonsmooth branch choices need not replay bit-for-bit across platforms or library versions. The literal saved checkpoints, the exact frozen rational inputs and the separate exact verifier do not depend on a repeat of the optimizer.

Save source-fence contents in parts 1 and 2 as UTF-8/LF, with one trailing newline. Save each JSON fence in this part WITHOUT a trailing newline: the byte hashes below refer to that convention. To recover automatically, save the three materials as green_numerical_part1.md, green_numerical_part2.md and green_numerical_part3.md in a new directory, then run this complete standard-library extraction command:

```sh
python -B -S - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re, hashlib
count=0
for part in range(1,4):
    text=Path(f'green_numerical_part{part}.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    for name,body in re.findall(r'^## ([A-Za-z0-9_]+\.(?:py|json))\n```(?:python|json)\n(.*?)\n```',text,re.M|re.S):
        data=(body+('\n' if name.endswith('.py') else '')).encode('utf-8')
        Path(name).write_bytes(data)
        print(name,len(data),hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest());count+=1
assert count==16,count
print('GREEN_NUMERICAL_SOURCE_RECOVERY_PASS')
PY
```

The direct-section seed scout is `python stack_scout.py`. A direct unconstrained PL continuation is `python stack_opt.py 3 19 0 0`; its finite convexity penalties can fail, so no such raw output was accepted. A positive Green-parameter run is `python stack_green.py 3 19 0`, default6000 Adam steps, learning rate .004, local margin .0001. GreenModel.run records an after-step checkpoint when a pre-step loss improves; its separately recomputed report is the meaningful diagnostic, not an asserted exact equality of the recorded nomination and pre-step scalar. The saved literal green_3_19_0.json is sufficient for every continuation below, without rerunning that nomination.

The actual fixed-knot metric continuation and exact freeze are:

```sh
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python stack_green_metric.py green_3_19_0.json max 6000
python freeze_green.py metric_3_19_max.json 1000000000
```

The second command was replayed against the literal checkpoint in this capsule and produces GREEN_TRI_C472_MAX_G9_INPUT.json, 1853bytes, SHA256 9f00de5d6efad1be2e5366dc65be1fc699f02529d8712e7570320b3a8fb4a816. Its identity is hardcoded for this historical candidate: a NEW freeze must explicitly use a NEW identity instead of overwriting/aliasing it. Forest, complete-point local and adaptive-radius attempts did not produce a110 nomination. They are reproducible methods with explicit starting input, not proved family exclusions. Older Model.report S lists include both central coplanar planes; do not silently call those lists maximal-facet counts. Persistence merges that known plane pair and deletes its common physical edge before its diagnostics.

## Whole-feature objective and meaningful negative results
For each physical or same-actual-centre polar true edge, compute the minimum squared radius on the chord. Descending-edge union-find gives every finite H0 bar; the selected birth/death indices are detached for the floating branch choice, while the corresponding scores remain differentiable. Positive relative depth is max(0,1-death/birth). Linear mode minimizes the sum of relative depths, square mode their squares, log mode the sum of squared log(birth/death). These are floating nominations, not exact simultaneous-event certificates. The separate rational verifier batches exact equal events and keeps every positive bar.

The linear-relative-depth loss has a saturation failure: a single very deep bar costs less than1, so the search can trade many moderate features for a nearly total radial separation. The saved fixed-linear endpoint has Psum .09332603604527567, Qsum1.0030962895757896, Pmax .06716210135302225, Qmax .9968265016909525, numerical S5/U81 and loss1.0971262219585012. This is a negative method result, not a proposed near110 figure. All values here come from the complete literal checkpoint below, not a guessed progress trace.

Log mode removes that saturation but still did not cancel the complete features. Saved fixed-log: Psum .8488853051583771,Qsum .9631382270490265,Pmax .4887378365373608,Qmax .5091167594106143,numerical S25/U11,loss1.2961673219326337. Saved adaptive-log: Psum .8336801179307951,Qsum .959306741016211,Pmax .4868277222076427,Qmax .5063179100177566,numerical S21/U9,loss1.278416966281557. New small births appeared while large features remained. These checkpoints are preserved as continuation resources, not rationally audited constructions or family obstructions.

A changed-width scout reallocates the same edge budget between longitudinal rings and circumferential routes. For odd n and2k+1 rings, the single central merger gives V=n(2k+1)+2,E=n(4k+3)-1,F=n(2k+2)-1. Thus(n,k)=(5,11),(7,8),(9,6) have C468,C488,C484 respectively. These 6000-step, seed0 max-local scouts retained numerical(S,U)=(29,65),(35,19),(43,39). The largest relative(P,Q) depths were(.175154,.261059),(.507034,.169209),(.140419,.191218). Smaller individual bars can coexist with many equilibria; none is a110 candidate. The complete literal checkpoints preserve every parameter. No exact rational polyhedral capsule is claimed for them, and no general width exclusion follows.

The strict C2 central stable/unstable construction and exact mass/convexity theorem remain useful. The unresolved frontier is genuinely whole-feature deformation with sufficient circumferential and longitudinal escape, possibly freed polygon geometry, changed incidence or broken symmetry; a local arrow scalar, a low maximum bar alone, or an unsourced count is not success.
